metadata.question: Was the percentage of cloud cover over Lago Hermoso, Argentina higher on March 29, 1987 (morning) compared to February 15, 2001?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Lago Hermoso, Argentina location (need to find coordinates) - Two specific dates: March 29, 1987 (morning) and February 15, 2001 - Need cloud cover percentage data - For 1987: Landsat 4/5 TM available - For 2001: Landsat 7 ETM+ available - Use morning acquisition filters (local time) 2. Masking strategy: - This question is ABOUT clouds, so we should NOT mask clouds - Instead, calculate cloud cover percentage from the available cloud bands or QA bands - Landsat uses pixel_qa or other quality bands to identify clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: 0% cloud cover is a valid answer - C1: No images found for the dates/location - C2: Not applicable here (we're analyzing clouds, not masking them) - C3: If cloud calculation returns None/NaN - Compare the two percentages and determine if 1987 > 2001 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Lago Hermoso, Argentina coordinates (approximate center) const lagoHermoso = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.28, -40.85]); const region = lagoHermoso.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer for analysis // Date 1: March 29, 1987 (morning) const date1Start = '1987-03-29'; const date1End = '1987-03-30'; // Date 2: February 15, 2001 const date2Start = '2001-02-15'; const date2End = '2001-02-16'; // Function to calculate cloud percentage from Landsat function calculateCloudPercentage(image, geometry) { const cloudBit = 1 << 5; // Cloud bit in pixel_qa const cloudShadowBit = 1 << 3; // Cloud shadow bit const qa = image.select('pixel_qa'); const clouds = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).neq(0); const total = ee.Image.constant(1); const stats = total.addBands(clouds).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats; } // Try Landsat 5 for 1987 let col1987 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C01/T1_SR') .filterBounds(lagoHermoso) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End); const size1987 = col1987.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1987 Images found: ${size1987}`); if (size1987 === 0) { // Try Landsat 4 col1987 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT04/C01/T1_SR') .filterBounds(lagoHermoso) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End); const size1987_L4 = col1987.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1987 Landsat 4 Images found: ${size1987_L4}`); if (size1987_L4 === 0) { console.log('No images for March 29, 1987'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Try Landsat 7 for 2001 let col2001 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C01/T1_SR') .filterBounds(lagoHermoso) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End); const size2001 = col2001.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2001 Images found: ${size2001}`); if (size2001 === 0) { console.log('No images for February 15, 2001'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get first image from each collection const img1987 = ee.Image(col1987.first()); const img2001 = ee.Image(col2001.first()); // Calculate cloud percentages const stats1987 = calculateCloudPercentage(img1987, region); const stats2001 = calculateCloudPercentage(img2001, region); const total1987 = stats1987.get('constant').getInfo(); const clouds1987 = stats1987.get('pixel_qa').getInfo(); const total2001 = stats2001.get('constant').getInfo(); const clouds2001 = stats2001.get('pixel_qa').getInfo(); if (total1987 === null || clouds1987 === null || total2001 === null || clouds2001 === null) { console.log('Calculation failure'); console.log('C3'); return; } const cloudPct1987 = (clouds1987 / total1987) * 100; const cloudPct2001 = (clouds2001 / total2001) * 100; console.log(`1987 Cloud Cover: ${cloudPct1987.toFixed(2)}% (${clouds1987}/${total1987} pixels)`); console.log(`2001 Cloud Cover: ${cloudPct2001.toFixed(2)}% (${clouds2001}/${total2001} pixels)`); if (cloudPct1987 > cloudPct2001) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
